name: O-RAN SC SMO VES Collector
what_it_is: An O-RAN Service Management and Orchestration (SMO) component that collects VES (Virtual Event Streaming) events posted by O-RAN network elements and pipelines them through Kafka into InfluxDB for persistence and Grafana for visualization. It implements the ONAP VES collector interface for O-RAN performance measurement (PM) and event data.
components: smo-collector: HTTP/HTTPS VES event receiver (port 9999), publishes events to Kafka topic
smo-dmaap-adapter: DMaaP-to-Kafka bridge adapter (port 5000), translates DMaaP messages to Kafka
smo-influxdb-connector: Kafka consumer that writes measurement data to InfluxDB (port 9990)
smo-post-config: One-shot init container that configures InfluxDB databases and Grafana dashboards
smo-kafka: Confluent Kafka broker (port 29092) for internal event streaming
smo-zookeeper: ZooKeeper coordination service for Kafka (port 22181)
smo-influxdb: InfluxDB 1.8.5 time-series database for PM data persistence (port 8086)
smo-grafana: Grafana 7.5.11 dashboard for PM data visualization (port 3000)
smo-kafdrop: Kafka topic browser UI (port 29000) for observability
protocols: TLS/HTTPS via mounted self-signed or third-party certificates
measurement: Performance Measurement (PM) events ingested via VES and stored in InfluxDB
Grafana dashboards configured automatically by smo-post-config for PM visualization
Kafka topic 'smo-events' carries all VES events between collector and downstream consumers
configuration: smo-collector env: smo_kafka_host, smo_kafka_port, smo_kafka_topic, collector_host, collector_port, collector_user, collector_pass, collector_path, loglevel, enable_assert
smo-dmaap-adapter env: kafka_host, kafka_port, log_level, enable_assert
smo-influxdb-connector env: smo_influxdb_host, smo_influxdb_port, smo_kafka_host, smo_kafka_port, loglevel, enable_assert
smo-post-config env: smo_influxdb_host, smo_influxdb_port, smo_grafana_host, smo_grafana_port, smo_grafana_auth
TLS certificates mounted from ~/ves-certificate host directory into /opt/smo/certs (vescertificate.key, vescertificate.csr, vescertificate.crt)
Grafana default credentials: admin:admin (set via smo_grafana_auth)
fault_injection: enable_assert flag on collector and dmaap-adapter (set to 'True' to enable assertion checks for testing)
loglevel configurable per service (DEBUG/ERROR) to increase verbosity during fault investigation
modes: HTTP mode: collector listens without TLS when no certificates are mounted
HTTPS/TLS mode: collector uses certificates from ~/ves-certificate volume mount
DMaaP ingestion mode: events arrive via smo-dmaap-adapter from DMaaP bus
Direct VES mode: events POST directly to smo-collector:9999
constraints: Certificates MUST be pre-created and placed in ~/ves-certificate on the host before starting the stack; the collector will not generate them automatically
The hostname 'smo-influxdb' must be resolvable from any external client machine accessing Grafana — requires a manual /etc/hosts entry on the client
All custom O-RAN images (collector, dmaap-adapter, influxdb-connector, post-config) are pulled from nexus3.o-ran-sc.org:10002 and are not available on Docker Hub
Kafka is configured with replication factor 1 — single-broker only, not suitable for multi-node HA deployment
Kafka advertised listener for external access is hardcoded to localhost:39092 — external non-localhost access requires reconfiguration
InfluxDB version pinned to 1.8.5 (v1 API) — incompatible with InfluxDB 2.x API clients
notable_absences: No authentication or authorization on Kafka broker (PLAINTEXT only, no SASL/SSL)
No VES schema validation configuration exposed — collector accepts any valid VES event structure
No persistent volumes defined for Kafka, Grafana, or InfluxDB in docker-compose — data is lost on container restart
No health checks defined for any service in docker-compose
No fault/alarm event domain handling explicitly documented — focus is PM/measurement data
